verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web/UI framework, and an event-driven rules or automation feature is a plausible ecosystem capability, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules that trigger actions on events. The dev server restarting on file changes and island event handlers are only adjacent developer building blocks, not a rules-based automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
